races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Runman
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with class edge, long absence (208 days) is the main concern but Gosden excels with returning horses.

runners_data.name: Hattie's Comet
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity after break, significantly higher OR than rivals but trainer's recent form is poor and going preference unclear.

runners_data.name: Vitality
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who will press from the start, recent run at Chepstow suggests he's in good heart but faces stiffer task here.

runners_data.name: Get Outta Here
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can avoid early pace battle while staying close enough to strike, Menuisier's 1/16 strike rate is concerning.

runners_data.name: Thomas Picton
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade tendency, quick return after 18th place suggests connections aren't concerned about his fitness.

runners_data.name: Fizzy Bear
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner who needs strong pace to aim at, trainer's 0/3 record in last fortnight doesn't inspire confidence.

runners_data.name: Hengest
runners_data.note: Older hold-up horse carrying penalty, consistent on good ground but hasn't shown winning form for some time.

runners_data.name: Mick The Hat
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from shrewd Beckett stable, recent efforts suggest he's competitive at this level without threatening to win.

runners_data.name: Pureis King
runners_data.note: Front-running four-year-old who fades late, likely to ensure honest gallop but penalty and fade pattern work against him.

races.paceDynamic: Vitality and Pureis King will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to engage from the start. This creates an honest gallop that should set up the race nicely for those held up off the pace. With five hold-up horses in the field including classy Runman, the early leaders risk burning each other out on Epsom's undulating track. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Vitality and Pureis King duel early and weaken approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest early pace sets up perfectly for the closers, with Runman's class telling and other hold-up types filling the frame. Epsom's demanding finish rewards horses with something left in reserve.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Get Outta Here positions perfectly behind the leaders without getting involved early
scenarios.body: The Menuisier runner can track the pace and strike when the front pair weaken, using his tactical speed to full advantage. This scenario suits horses that can sit handy but avoid the early burn.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Vitality or Pureis King gets an uncontested lead while the other fades early
scenarios.body: Without a sustained pace duel, the surviving leader can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back in this moderate company. Vitality's superior rating gives him the edge in this outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Hattie's Comet shows significantly improved form from his break and runs to his OR 120 rating
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runner could have been working well at home and might outclass this field if near his best. His unknown current form makes this a low-probability but high-impact scenario.

watchPoints.text: Vitality and Pureis King engaging in a sustained speed duel through the first half-mile will set up the race for closers.
Runman's market support after 208-day break - if well-backed he's clearly showing good work at home for the master trainer.
Get Outta Here's early positioning - needs to sit handy without getting drawn into pace battle to maximize his chances.
Hattie's Comet's debut run for new connections - any positive market move would suggest significant improvement from his break.
How Thomas Picton handles Epsom's undulations given his tendency to fade - the unique track might help or hinder his finishing effort.

races.name: Betfred Blue Riband Trial Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Balzac
runners_data.note: Front runner faces pace pressure from Menzies but Hollie Doyle excels in tactical battles and 27 days since last run suggests freshness for this step up in class.

runners_data.name: Saxon Street
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making seasonal return after 131 days off but Gosden stable excels with returning horses and William Buick's positioning skills crucial at Epsom.

runners_data.name: New Zealand
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with proven class advantage holds RPR 116 but 184-day absence and inconsistent recent form creates uncertainty despite O'Brien's Epsom expertise.

runners_data.name: Rebel Rocker
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on long absence faces significant class rise but low-key connections may struggle in Listed company despite maiden win last time.

runners_data.name: Menzies
runners_data.note: Front runner likely to press Balzac early but modest recent form and trainer's poor 14-day record suggest vulnerable after setting strong pace.

runners_data.name: Pearl River
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces longest absence at 202 days and needs significant improvement from soft ground form to compete at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Balzac and Menzies will clash from the gate, both natural front runners who should ensure a genuine pace from the start. With only 6 runners, the pace could become moderate if one capitulates early, but both have shown determination when leading and should maintain honest fractions through the middle sections. The combination of Epsom's undulations and a true gallop will test stamina reserves in the final 2f, creating opportunities for hold-up horses to close. This race shape strongly favours closers and prominent racers who can finish, penalising pure pace-setters who may pay for their early efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Balzac and Menzies maintain their duel through halfway
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will stretch the field and expose stamina limitations of the pace-setters. New Zealand and Saxon Street can exploit their superior closing kicks over this stiff 1m2f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Contested Pace
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter backs down early leaving a solo leader
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows all horses to travel comfortably into the straight where class tells. Balzac or the surviving leader maintains energy for the finish while closers lack the fierce pace to close the gap.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Slow Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are restrained creating an unusually pedestrian gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters most. Hold-up horses may get caught too far back on Epsom's complex track configuration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If serious interference or early fall disrupts the anticipated pace battle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where experience and race-reading become crucial factors. The Gosden-trained Saxon Street benefits from stable expertise in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Menzies could compromise own chance by engaging in suicidal early pace battle with Balzac given moderate recent form
New Zealand's long absence and tendency to race keenly could see Ryan Moore struggle for tactical position in small field
Saxon Street's fitness after 131-day break will be evident in final furlong if still travelling strongly
Pearl River faces significant step up in class and distance after 202-day layoff with unproven hold-up style at this trip
Early pace development between Balzac and Menzies will determine whether closers get optimal race shape

races.name: Lilley Plummer Risks City & Suburban Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Sallaal
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces the challenge of a potentially controlled pace but brings the highest class with RPR 112 and strong form on good ground

runners_data.name: Rathgar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner ideally positioned for this race shape with strong recent form and Tom Marquand's 10-day gap suggests freshness

runners_data.name: Aurel
runners_data.note: The lone front-runner returning from 311-day layoff but Ralph Beckett excels with returning horses and gets uncontested lead

runners_data.name: Parlando
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needs strong pace to be effective, 7-day turnaround suggests connections are confident in his fitness

runners_data.name: Asmen Warrior
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits perfectly with excellent recent consistency and the cheekpieces maintain his focus

runners_data.name: Duke's Command
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with proven stamina but needs the race to develop into a strong test over the final 3f

runners_data.name: Dangerman
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 200-day break for the powerful Gosden stable with blinkers applied for sharpness

races.paceDynamic: Aurel is the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead with Rathgar, Dangerman and Asmen Warrior settling in prominent positions behind. The pace will be genuine but sustainable with no early pressure on Aurel, allowing the tempo to build gradually through the middle stages. Hold-up horses Sallaal, Parlando and Duke's Command will need to rely on the pace quickening sufficiently in the final 3f to bring them into contention. This controlled tempo strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and strike turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses can stalk Aurel comfortably and produce their challenge 2f out
scenarios.body: Rathgar, Dangerman or Asmen Warrior get first run on the pacesetter before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. The controlled early gallop allows them to conserve energy while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the 4f marker and creates a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and allow Sallaal or Duke's Command to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. Their class advantage becomes decisive in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Aurel maintains his advantage and the closing horses fail to reach him
scenarios.body: The pacesetter's uncontested lead proves decisive as he has enough left in the tank to repel late challenges. His recent 311-day break may have freshened him up perfectly for this assignment.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too slow and it becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure speed over the final quarter-mile rather than stamina. This plays into the hands of horses with natural gate speed who can quicken late.

watchPoints.text: Aurel could steal this if the field allows him too soft a lead early and fails to apply pressure until too late
Sallaal needs the pace to be honest throughout - watch for early positioning as hold-up horses must be closer than usual here
Rathgar's early positioning will be crucial - if Marquand sits too far back he loses the tactical advantage this race offers
The 4f to 2f section will determine the outcome - if the pace doesn't quicken here the closers are in serious trouble
Asmen Warrior's consistent runner-up efforts suggest he's ready to strike when getting the right race shape like this

races.name: Weatherbys Global Stallions App Great Metropolitan Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Night Breeze
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to favoured turf after close AW third, with tongue-tie applied for first time and Ryan's 0/23 record for Ian Williams concerning.
runners_data.comment: Two 1m4f wins at Ascot (good to firm) last year; latest AW run was up with his best form
runners_data.spotlight: Won off just 1lb lower at Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) last August, his second win there last year; 0-12 on AW but close third on latest start (first with tongue tied) was up with his best form; should go well.

runners_data.name: Asgard's Captain
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with strong recent form, though 46-day break and Dylan Cunha's modest 1/18 strike-rate are minor negatives.

runners_data.name: Sing Us A Song
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 214-day layoff with Doyle aboard, needing a truly-run race to showcase his superior official rating of 95.

runners_data.name: Topteam
runners_data.note: Front-running type in excellent form with three wins from last five starts, perfectly positioned to control the tempo with Murphy's tactical nous.

runners_data.name: Nunc Est Bibendum
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping up significantly in class but carrying just 116lbs, with recent AW form his only current guide to wellbeing.

races.paceDynamic: Topteam will dictate proceedings from the front with Night Breeze and Asgard's Captain settling prominently behind. The lone leader setup means Topteam can control fractions without early pressure, while the hold-up pair Sing Us A Song and Nunc Est Bibendum face the challenge of making ground from off the pace. With only five runners and one confirmed pace-setter, this creates a sustainable tempo that strongly favours prominent racers and the leader, as the hold-up horses will struggle to generate the necessary turn of foot in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Topteam Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Topteam gets uncontested fractions and maintains his recent form peak
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate comfortable splits and kick clear turning for home, making it very difficult for closers to peg back. His class edge on these ratings combined with tactical advantage makes him formidable.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Night Breeze or Asgard's Captain apply early pressure to Topteam
scenarios.body: The pace quickens sufficiently to set up the hold-up horses, with the prominent trio potentially coming back to the closers late. Asgard's Captain's consistent form gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely crawling and Doyle times his move perfectly
scenarios.body: Sing Us A Song's class tells as he sweeps past tired leaders, capitalizing on his 214-day break freshness. The Ralph Beckett-trained runner has the highest official rating to exploit a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If Nunc Est Bibendum's weight advantage (14lbs below top weight) proves decisive
scenarios.body: The bottom-weight gets a perfect tow into the race and his recent AW form translates better than expected to turf. His trainer's 1/25 strike-rate suggests this is more hopeful than probable.

watchPoints.text: Topteam breaking slowly would completely alter race dynamics as Night Breeze or Asgard's Captain could inherit an uncontested lead
Sing Us A Song showing early enthusiasm after his long break, which would compromise his hold-up style and waste his finishing kick
The pace through the first half-mile will determine whether hold-up horses get their optimal scenario or if prominent runners dominate
Asgard's Captain getting trapped behind horses turning for home, as he needs a clear passage to utilize his consistent finishing effort
Night Breeze's response to the tongue-tie first-time, as headgear changes can dramatically alter a horse's racing behavior and style

races.name: Betfred 'Nifty 50' Handicap

runners_data.name: Timber Twelve
runners_data.note: Strong recent form but will face his toughest pace test yet with two other confirmed leaders ensuring no easy lead

runners_data.name: On Message
runners_data.note: Returns from 204-day break but his class suggests he can handle this company if fitness holds up

runners_data.name: Mayaada
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed to track the early pace battle then strike when leaders weaken

runners_data.name: Terranoble
runners_data.note: Hold-up style ideally suited to this pace scenario but trainer's poor recent record raises questions

runners_data.name: Assaranca
runners_data.note: Another front-runner adding to the pace pressure but his moderate recent efforts suggest vulnerability when tested

runners_data.name: Montague Menace
runners_data.note: Classic closer with Oisin Murphy's tactical skills crucial to timing the run from off the strong pace

races.paceDynamic: Timber Twelve, On Message, and Assaranca will create a fierce early battle for the lead, guaranteeing a strong gallop from the start. The presence of three confirmed front-runners means the early pace will be fierce and unrelenting, especially with Timber Twelve's recent wins showing he won't back down. This sustained pressure will see the pace-setters tire in the final furlong as the stamina-sapping test takes its toll. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can deliver late kicks - Terranoble and Montague Menace are perfectly positioned to capitalise.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders engage in their expected early battle creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the front-runners' stamina reserves, allowing the closers to pick up the pieces. Terranoble and Montague Menace can time their challenges perfectly as tired leaders fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Under Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Timber Twelve can break clear of On Message and Assaranca early and dictate terms
scenarios.body: His recent back-to-back wins show he has the class edge when the heat is on. The favourite can control the tempo just enough to have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mayaada Times It Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner can sit just behind the early battle without getting involved
scenarios.body: From her ideal position tracking the pace, she can strike when the leaders weaken but before the hold-up horses arrive. Her trainer's excellent recent form adds confidence to this tactical approach.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three leaders can gain a decisive early advantage and steal crucial lengths
scenarios.body: Despite the pace battle, the winner gets enough of a break to hold off late challengers. This requires tactical errors from rivals or track bias favoring front-runners.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any of the three front-runners (Timber Twelve, On Message, Assaranca) can steal an early break as this could negate the pace advantage
Monitor Terranoble's position turning for home - if he's too far back when the pace kicks up, even this strong gallop won't help
Check Mayaada's early positioning - if she gets caught up in the pace battle rather than tracking it, her chance diminishes significantly
Observe Montague Menace's split-second timing - Murphy must judge the exact moment when leaders tire but before other closers strike

races.name: Betfred 'In Celebration Of Mark Friar' Handicap

runners_data.name: Kaleido
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 271 days but David O'Meara excels with horses back from breaks

runners_data.name: Mr Baloo
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist in excellent current form with strong recent Sandown win, headgear added suggests connections expect improvement

runners_data.name: Sweet Reward
runners_data.note: Reliable prominent runner with veteran's tactical knowledge, Olivia Tubb's 5lb claim valuable at this level

runners_data.name: Knights Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid Epsom course form, recent run at Lingfield suggests fitness maintained

runners_data.name: Organ
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up type but 220-day absence is concerning despite excellent record fresh for Martyn Meade

runners_data.name: Carnival Day
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 182-day break, needs everything to fall right from difficult style

runners_data.name: Amused
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with headgear applied, Pierre-Louis Jamin booking suggests positive stable confidence

runners_data.name: Tribal Rhythm
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent recent form, Oisin Murphy's presence indicates strong chance

runners_data.name: Shafdar
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with decent recent Lingfield form but needs significant improvement from back of handicap

runners_data.name: Tronido
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse getting 7lb from Hollie Doyle but bottom weight suggests limited ability at this level

races.paceDynamic: Kaleido and Sweet Reward will likely set the early pace as the only confirmed prominent runners, with Amused also capable of tracking close. The majority field of hold-up horses including Mr Baloo, Knights Gold, Organ, Carnival Day, Tribal Rhythm, Shafdar and Tronido creates a crowded mid-division with limited early speed. This sustainable pace setup with seven hold-up runners means they'll be relying on each other for finishing kicks in the straight. The lack of genuine early pace pressure strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the speed and have first run on the field turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kaleido and Sweet Reward maintain sensible fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters control the race and kick clear when the hold-up brigade are still organising their challenges. Prominent runners exploit their positional advantage on Epsom's demanding track where position matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pair go too steady allowing closers to pounce
scenarios.body: Mr Baloo and Organ utilise their proven hold-up style to deliver strong finishing efforts. The tactical pace allows patient riders to time their challenges perfectly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Pressure Changes
scenarios.trigger: If Amused or another forces the pace earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for a strong closer like Tribal Rhythm to exploit. Oisin Murphy times his challenge to perfection on the improving five-year-old.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits From Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses interfere with each other in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: Tronido benefits from the improved handicap mark and Hollie Doyle's 7lb claim becomes decisive. The veteran finds gaps when others are stopped in their tracks.

watchPoints.text: Kaleido has been off for 271 days and if showing any signs of rustiness early could compromise the pace scenario
Sweet Reward versus Kaleido battle for early position could create unexpected tempo if both are keen
Mr Baloo's recent Sandown form is strong but hold-up horses need everything to fall right in small fields
Tribal Rhythm with Oisin Murphy represents stable confidence and could be value if pace develops as expected
Amused with headgear first time and claims could outrun odds if able to track the principals early
